questionText:
Trace the state of the array [40, 30, 20, 10] after each insertion pass from index 1 to index 3:
(A) Initial state: [40] is sorted; unsorted segment is [30, 20, 10]
(B) Pass 1 (key=30): Shift 40 right, insert 30 -> Array: [30, 40, 20, 10]
(C) Pass 2 (key=20): Shift 40 and 30 right, insert 20 -> Array: [20, 30, 40, 10]
(D) Pass 3 (key=10): Shift 40, 30, and 20 right, insert 10 -> Array: [10, 20, 30, 40]

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: B, A, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A, C, B, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A, B, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text: D, B, C, A
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Insertion sort passes: start [40] -> insert 30 yields [30,40] -> insert 20 yields [20,30,40] -> insert 10 yields [10,20,30,40].
Hence, Option A is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.

questionText:
Trace the step-by-step swaps during Pass 1 of Bubble Sort on the array: [50, 20, 40, 10, 30]:
(A) Compare 50 and 20: 50 > 20 -> Swap -> Array: [20, 50, 40, 10, 30]
(B) Compare 50 and 40: 50 > 40 -> Swap -> Array: [20, 40, 50, 10, 30]
(C) Compare 50 and 10: 50 > 10 -> Swap -> Array: [20, 40, 10, 50, 30]
(D) Compare 50 and 30: 50 > 30 -> Swap -> Array: [20, 40, 10, 30, 50] (50 is now in its final sorted position)

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: A, B, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text: B, A, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A, C, B, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: D, B, C, A
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Pass 1 pushes largest element (50) to the end: [50,20] swap -> [50,40] swap -> [50,10] swap -> [50,30] swap -> 50 fixed at end.
Hence, Option D is correct.
Hence, option (A) is correct.
